name: Kashmiri Pashmina
description: Hand-spun and hand-woven luxury fabric derived from the fine undercoat of Changthangi goats (Capra hircus). Celebrated for its warmth, microscopic fiber fineness (12-16 microns), and traditional diamond-shaped twill weave known as 'Chashm-e-Bulbul'.

keyFeatures.name: Fiber Fineness
keyFeatures.expected: 12 to 16 microns (hair-like microscopic lightness)

keyFeatures.name: Weave Structure
keyFeatures.expected: Chashm-e-Bulbul (Bird's Eye / Diamond twill) or plain weave with irregular organic warp-weft tension

keyFeatures.name: Motif Style
keyFeatures.expected: Chinar leaf, Paisley (Badam), Floral creeper, Cypress pine
keyFeatures.technique: Sozni needle embroidery or Kani twill-tapestry

keyFeatures.name: Dye Characteristics
keyFeatures.expected: Vegetal & natural mineral dyes with subtle soft tonality; no synthetic chemical odor

name: Banarasi Brocade & Silk
description: World-renowned ancient opulent textile craft from Varanasi, crafted on pit looms using pure mulberry silk (Katan), real gold and silver metallic threads (Zari), and complex Jacquard or Naksha jala harnesses. Notable for its dense foliage, jaal, and mina work.

keyFeatures.name: Zari Composition
keyFeatures.expected: Silver alloy core coated with pure gold; distinctive matte metallic sheen that doesn't tarnish rapidly
keyFeatures.technique: Kalabattun spinning on pure silk thread

keyFeatures.name: Weave Reverse Side
keyFeatures.expected: Floating extra-weft threads (Khaddi / Kadhwa) with hand-clipped floats, or interlocking tapestry mina joints

keyFeatures.name: Signature Motifs
keyFeatures.expected: Kalka (Paisley), Shikargah (Hunting scenes), Beldar creepers, Latifa Buti, and Mughal floral bouquets

keyFeatures.name: Fabric Lustre & Fall
keyFeatures.expected: Heavy natural drape with crisp dual-tone lustre; no synthetic oily shimmer

name: Jaipur Blue Pottery
description: Unique traditional pottery developed under Maharaja Sawai Ram Singh II. Unlike regular pottery, it uses NO CLAY; it is composed of Egyptian paste made of ground quartz stone, Fuller's earth (Multani Mitti), glass frit, katira gum, and natural soda water, fired once at low temperatures.

keyFeatures.name: Body Material
keyFeatures.expected: Clay-free, translucent crystalline quartz dough; pale granular core visible at unglazed base
keyFeatures.technique: Open mold press with quartz frit paste

keyFeatures.name: Glaze & Palette
keyFeatures.expected: Cobalt oxide (royal blue), Copper oxide (turquoise/green), and iron oxide (yellow/brown) under clear glass glaze

keyFeatures.name: Painting Style
keyFeatures.expected: Freehand brushwork with subtle brushstroke line variations; Persian rosettes, peacocks, floral vines

keyFeatures.name: Tactile Texture
keyFeatures.expected: Subtle organic surface crazing (fine micro-crackle in glaze) and cool quartz feel to touch

name: Madhubani Painting (Mithila)
description: Ancient folk art form practiced by women of Mithila region in Bihar. Characterized by eye-catching geometrical patterns, line drawings with double outlines, fish, lotus, peacock motifs, and complete absence of empty space (filled with birds, flowers, and geometric patterns).

keyFeatures.name: Line Work Style
keyFeatures.expected: Kachni (fine line hatching) or Bharni (solid color fill) executed with double outlines and cross-hatching
keyFeatures.technique: Bamboo twig nibs (kalam) wrapped with raw cotton

keyFeatures.name: Pigment Composition
keyFeatures.expected: 100% natural pigments: Lampblack/kajal (black), turmeric (yellow), indigo (blue), madder (red), bilwa tree juice
keyFeatures.technique: Vegetable and mineral extracts mixed with goat milk/gum

keyFeatures.name: Substrate Base
keyFeatures.expected: Handmade paper treated with cow dung wash (giving pale amber warmth) or pure Tussar/Mulberry silk

keyFeatures.name: Compositional Density
keyFeatures.expected: Horror Vacui (fear of empty space) - every void is adorned with flora, fauna, and geometric filler lines

name: Channapatna Wooden Toys
description: Traditional turned-wood craft originating from Tipu Sultan's era, earned Channapatna the title 'Gombegala Ooru' (Town of Toys). Made exclusively from sustainably sourced Wrightia tinctoria (Aale mara / Ivory Wood) and colored with 100% non-toxic vegetable dyes and lac.

keyFeatures.name: Wood Type
keyFeatures.expected: Wrightia tinctoria (Ivory Wood / Aale mara) - soft, fine-grained, splinter-free, pale cream timber

keyFeatures.name: Coloring Agent
keyFeatures.expected: Natural lacquer pigmented with turmeric (yellow), indigo (blue), katha (brown), and kumkum (red)

keyFeatures.name: Polishing & Finish
keyFeatures.expected: Glass-like high buff shine achieved naturally without artificial varnish; completely child-safe and edible-grade non-toxic
keyFeatures.technique: Talipot palm leaf (screwworm leaf) dry burnishing

keyFeatures.name: Safety & Edges
keyFeatures.expected: Zero sharp edges; all contours turned smooth with radiused fillets

name: Kancheepuram Silk Sari
description: Renowned as the queen of South Indian handlooms, woven with three-ply heavy mulberry silk twisted with silver/gold zari. Distinguished by its heavy weight, contrast borders attached using the intricate Korvai interlocking technique, and temple gopuram motifs.

keyFeatures.name: Korvai Interlocking Joint
keyFeatures.expected: Jagged tooth or stepped interlocking line joining border and body, requiring two weavers at the pit loom

keyFeatures.name: Silk Ply & Weight
keyFeatures.expected: Heavy gauge fabric woven from 3-ply twisted mulberry silk threads (Murukku pattu), weighing 600g to 1000g+

keyFeatures.name: Zari Certification
keyFeatures.expected: Traditional zari contains 57% silver and 0.6% pure gold over a silk core (Brahmin Zari standard)

keyFeatures.name: Pallu Connection (Petni)
keyFeatures.expected: Distinct zigzag interlocking joint where the pallu is woven separately and integrated into the body

name: Bastar Dhokra Bell Metal
description: Ancient lost-wax hollow casting technique (cire perdue) practiced for over 4,000 years since the Mohenjo-daro Dancing Girl. Tribal artisans of Bastar hand-mold beeswax filaments into organic animal figures, tribal deities, and lamps before casting in bell metal alloy.

keyFeatures.name: Filament Wire Detailing
keyFeatures.expected: Organic, hand-coiled wire-like textures covering the surface with subtle hand-pressed variations

keyFeatures.name: Metal Alloy Composition
keyFeatures.expected: Traditional bell metal (Kansa: 78% Copper, 22% Tin) or recycled brass alloy giving rich antique tone

keyFeatures.name: Core Construction
keyFeatures.expected: Hollow inside with residual baked red/black ant-hill clay core audible or visible inside figures
keyFeatures.technique: Two-stage clay core and mold preparation

keyFeatures.name: Surface Finish
keyFeatures.expected: Warm golden-brown antique patina with natural casting textures, never mirror-polished or machine-sanded
keyFeatures.technique: River sand buffing and mustard oil wash

name: Kolhapuri Chappals
description: Handcrafted open-toed leather footwear made using vegetable-tanned buffalo and goat leather. Stitched entirely with leather cord (no iron nails or chemical adhesives), seasoned with mustard and castor oils, and decorated with delicate leather braids and pompoms.

keyFeatures.name: Tanning Method
keyFeatures.expected: Vegetable tanning with Babul bark (Acacia nilotica) and Harda (Myrobalan) nuts

keyFeatures.name: Stitching Medium
keyFeatures.expected: Braided raw leather thongs (Khara) securing sole to upper; completely free of metal nails or chemical glue

keyFeatures.name: Sole Structure
keyFeatures.expected: Multi-layered buffalo hide compressed with wooden mallet, yielding characteristic creaking sound (Kar-Kar)

keyFeatures.name: Aroma & Seasoning
keyFeatures.expected: Distinctive earthy, rich vegetable-oil and leather aroma from castor/mustard oil treatment
